consequence.statement: The validation.enforce-metric-name CLI flag and YAML configuration setting are no longer honoured and will be ignored by Loki 3.0.0.

original.statement: The validation.enforce-metric-name CLI flag and corresponding YAML setting are removed in Loki 3.0.0.

decision.reason: [ev-7b384eb00d22] says the `validation.enforce-metric-name` CLI flag and its YAML setting are removed in 3.0.0, under the upgrade-guide section "Deprecated configuration options are removed". The consequence vocabulary maps a removed key to setting-ignored, because a configured value is no longer honoured. That is action-eligible. The guide names no replacement for this key, unlike its neighbours [ev-dc20110f4f4b] and [ev-7b76cb015d7e]. The evidence does not say whether a leftover setting is silently ignored or stops Loki from starting, so "will be ignored" is an inference and confidence is low.
